gender.label: female
gender.evidence: I feel that he has the impression that you're just a girl, which I find quite annoying

school.label: Single sex
school.reasoning: Explicitly attended an all-girls grammar school.

dept.label: Design & Technology
dept.evidence: the course I'm doing because it's a bit more design orientated

special.label: agree
special.evidence: it was sort of the only one that would incorporate all 3 of my A levels, and I didn't want to drop any one in particular
special.reasoning: Wanted to keep maths/physics/art together without specialising in one.

interest.label: agree
interest.evidence: Basically just because I enjoyed it and I didn't want to like throw away any one of them
interest.reasoning: Chose course because she enjoyed the subjects; opportunity to do work she found interesting.

knowledg.label: agree
knowledg.evidence: I didn't really know an awful lot about it till I started it so it was just a fluke really
knowledg.reasoning: Explicitly chose with little knowledge of what the field involved.

family.label: disagree
family.evidence: Well my grandfather sort of did engineering, in a sense. … that was really about it
family.reasoning: Only a tenuous family link (grandfather 'in a sense'); parents not engineers, so weak family involvement.

careers.label: disagree
careers.evidence: our careers were quite good but I think they were a bit shocked when I decided to come here and do a sort of engineering
careers.reasoning: Careers service did not actively encourage engineering; were shocked by her choice.

nobody.label: disagree
nobody.evidence: a lot of the girls from my school have gone into sort of engineering or maths and that kind of field, anyway, so it wasn't really that big a surprise
nobody.reasoning: School supportive and family supportive, so it is not the case nobody encouraged her.

discoura.label: no
discoura.evidence: I don't think anybody's discouraged me, really much.
discoura.reasoning: States no one discouraged her (re placement); no discouragement from studying engineering surfaces.

placemen.label: yes
placemen.evidence: I suppose it depends what kind of placement I get at the end
placemen.reasoning: Intends to go on a sandwich/placement year; actively applying and expecting to secure a placement.

experien.label: Strongly agree
experien.evidence: Basically just getting experience, because everywhere they all – everybody just wants experience and if you don't have it then you know, it's a bit difficult to get a bit further
experien.reasoning: Work experience is the explicitly stated main reason for the sandwich course.

jobprosp.label: agree
jobprosp.evidence: you can say well I do have this behind me. I haven't like just come straight from university, I've actually been out there and worked for a while so, I think that'll help.
jobprosp.reasoning: Sees placement as improving employability after university.

jobdecid.label: agree
jobdecid.evidence: It'll tell me whether I absolutely hate engineering or love it, hopefully.
jobdecid.reasoning: Wants placement to help decide future direction.

industry.label: agree
industry.evidence: I've actually been out there and worked for a while
industry.reasoning: Wants to experience what industry is really like.

perdevel.label: agree
perdevel.evidence: confidence and the ability to like work for a company and to not have it all go wrong hopefully
perdevel.reasoning: Hopes to gain confidence and personal development from placement.

relevanc.label: Strongly agree
relevanc.evidence: some of the modules that I have to do, I don't quite see the relevance of them … you don't feel you get anything from it
relevanc.reasoning: Strongly and elaborately reports difficulty seeing relevance of some modules.

pleased.label: agree
pleased.evidence: is a shock, but I enjoy it, so it's OK
pleased.reasoning: Says she enjoys the course and 'So far yeah' she is happy with her choices.

Fhelp.label: agree
Fhelp.evidence: you get a lot of help, so if you don't … you're not strong enough to do something then there's always plenty of people willing to help
Fhelp.reasoning: As a woman she gets more help offered; maps to female students getting more help.

groupwk.label: satisfied
groupwk.evidence: Yeah. If everybody pulls their weight, yeah.
groupwk.reasoning: Broadly positive about group work, conditional on people contributing.

interper.label: agree
interper.evidence: the skills like being organised and being able to work in groups and just getting on with work on your own – that kind of thing will definitely help
interper.reasoning: Course develops interpersonal/teamwork skills she expects to use.

friends.label: satisfied
friends.evidence: the best is probably – I dunno, apart from the people
friends.reasoning: Names the people as the best thing; worried about missing friends on placement.

supppers.label: satisfied
supppers.evidence: He's really approachable and he's a nice man, so I'm quite happy.
supppers.reasoning: Clearly satisfied with her (male) personal tutor.

supplect.label: satisfied
supplect.evidence: I think that the male teaching lecturers are really good anyway
supplect.reasoning: Positive about lecturers overall despite one or two who exclude her.

carpath.label: consultancy
carpath.evidence: I'd probably really like to work for some sort of consultancy – engineering design consultancy that type of thing.
carpath.reasoning: States ideal career is an engineering design consultancy.

workrole.label: managerial
workrole.evidence: I'm doing a management module at the minute, which I've really enjoyed so possibly
workrole.reasoning: Leans toward going into management long-term; enjoying management module.

location.label: important
location.evidence: location mainly – has been probably the strongest one
location.reasoning: Location explicitly the strongest factor in choosing where to work.

salary.label: neither important nor unimportant
salary.evidence: pay – a little bit but it's probably not as much as erm other things like where it actually is and what it does
salary.reasoning: Pay matters only a little, less than location/work content.

promot.label: unimportant
promot.evidence: if it's there then that'd be nice but I'm not really too bothered
promot.reasoning: Indifferent about prospects of a job/progression with the placement company.
